scripts.clear: bash -c 'shopt -s nullglob && rm -rf tests/*/*.tsbuildinfo && rm -rf tests/*/dist && rm -rf shared/*/dist frontend/app/*/dist frontend/app/*/dist-playwright backend/shared/*/dist backend/app/*/dist && rm -rf shared/*/*.tsbuildinfo frontend/app/*/*.tsbuildinfo backend/shared/*/*.tsbuildinfo backend/app/*/*.tsbuildinfo'
scripts.clear:backend:shared: bash -c 'shopt -s nullglob && rm -rf backend/shared/*/dist && rm -rf backend/shared/*/*.tsbuildinfo'
scripts.clear:global:shared: bash -c 'shopt -s nullglob && rm -rf shared/*/dist && rm -rf shared/*/*.tsbuildinfo'
scripts.clear:shared: pnpm run clear:global:shared && pnpm run clear:backend:shared
scripts.dev:build: pnpm run build:shared && STAMHOOFD_ENV=stamhoofd lerna run dev:build
scripts.dev:jambo: pnpm run stam dev all --env jambo
scripts.dev:keeo: pnpm run stam dev all --env keeo
scripts.dev:keeo:full: pnpm run stam dev all --env keeo
scripts.dev:ravot: pnpm run stam dev all --env ravot
scripts.dev:stamhoofd: pnpm run stam dev all --env stamhoofd
scripts.dev:stamhoofd:full: pnpm run stam dev all --env stamhoofd
scripts.dns: export SERVER_IP=127.0.0.1 && cd .development && source loadenv.sh && coredns
scripts.frontend:types: wait-on shared/locales/dist/index.d.ts && pnpm --dir frontend/app/dashboard run typecheck
scripts.migrate: pnpm run build:shared && lerna run migrations --concurrency 1
scripts.ship: node ./.development/increase-structures-version.js && pnpm run clear:shared && pnpm run build:shared && lerna version --exact --force-publish --yes --no-private && lerna publish from-git --yes --no-private --otp $(op item get NPM --otp || :) && pnpm run stam release publish
scripts.ship:fix: lerna publish from-git --yes --no-private --otp $(op item get NPM --otp || :) && pnpm run stam release publish
scripts.ship:force: node ./.development/increase-structures-version.js --force && pnpm run clear:shared && pnpm run build:shared && npm login && lerna version --exact --force-publish --yes --no-private && lerna publish from-git --yes --no-private --otp $(op item get NPM --otp || :) && pnpm run stam release publish
scripts.test:playwright: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --dir backend/app/api run build:playwright:pre && pnpm --dir tests/playwright run test
scripts.test:playwright:ui: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --dir backend/app/api run build:playwright:pre && pnpm --dir tests/playwright run test --ui
scripts.translate: pnpm run translate:keys && pnpm run translate:compress && pnpm run translate:machine
scripts.translate:compress: pnpm --dir shared/locales run build && pnpm --dir .development/i18n-uuid run merge-duplicates && pnpm --dir .development/i18n-uuid run unused-keys
scripts.translate:keys: pnpm --dir .development/i18n-uuid run replace-keys && pnpm --dir .development/i18n-uuid run replace-keys
scripts.translate:machine: pnpm --dir shared/locales run build && pnpm --dir .development/i18n-uuid run auto-translate
